status.en: 10 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Erbil and Sulaymaniyah.
status.nb: 10 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Erbil og Sulaymaniyah.

summary.en: Iraqi Prime Minister has dismissed nine officials linked to an oil-smuggling network in the pro-Iran stronghold of Babil and announced a special security force and energy police to protect pipelines. Kataib Hezbollah has rejected the findings of an oil probe in Jurf al-Nasr, accused the prime minister of yielding to US and Gulf pressure, and been given an end-of-week deadline by al-Zaidi to vacate the area, while al-Zaidi has threatened force to assert control over Jurf al-Sakhar. Bahrain has accused Iran of attacking its territory in retaliation for US actions, linking regional tensions to the Iraqi smuggling crackdown. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakisk statsminister har avsatt ni tjenestemenn knyttet til et oljesmuglingsnettverk i den pro-iranske festningsbyen Babil og kunngjort en spesiell sikkerhetsstyrke og energipolitiet for å beskytte rørledninger. Kataib Hezbollah har avvist funnene i en oljeundersøkelse i Jurf al-Nasr, anklaget statsministeren for å gi etter for press fra USA og Gulf, og fått en frist til slutten av uken av al-Zaidi for å forlate området, mens al-Zaidi har truet med makt for å hevde kontroll over Jurf al-Sakhar. Bahrain har anklaget Iran for å angripe sitt territorium som gjengjeldelse for amerikanske handlinger, og knyttet regionale spenninger til den irakiske smuglingsnedturen. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
